 This Miscellaneous First Appeal Is Filed Under
Section 173(1) Of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, Praying To Set
Aside The Common Judgment And Award Dated 09.11.2012,
Passed In Mvc No.12/2010, On The File Of The Court Of
Additional Senior Civil Judge, Laxmeshwar, Etc.,.
 These Appeals Coming On For Final Hearing This Day,
The Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment

These three appeals are filed by the insurance company challenging the common judgment and award dated 09.11.2012, passed by the tribunal, in MVC Nos.28/2010, 29/2010 and 12/2010,
challenging the liability fastened on the insurance company on the ground NC: 2023:KHC-D:12396 The Divisional Manager vs Husensab S/O Tajesab Attigeri on 12 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37883161/
4

that the insurance policy is Act policy/Liability only policy and since the injured persons have travelled in the jeep as unauthorized passengers, the risk of the inmates of the private vehicle are not covered under the Act policy/Liability only policy.
2. The factum of accident and injuries suffered by the claimants are not in dispute in these cases.
3. Heard the arguments and perused the records.
4. Admittedly in the present case the insurance policy pertaining to jeep No.GA-02/C-6121 is Act policy/Liability only policy, which is at Ex.R.1.

From the complaint averments and other material it is proved that the injured persons were waiting for the bus in order to go to their village; at that time the jeep approached them and the driver of the jeep has instructed to board the jeep and when the claimants were travelling as inmates in the jeep along with other 7-8 passengers, met with accident and sustained injuries.
Therefore it is proved that the NC: 2023:KHC-D:12396 claimants and other persons were travelling in the jeep.
Therefore, the claimants and other persons have travelled as gratuitous passengers.
Admittedly the vehicle in question is a private jeep which is not meant for using for commercial purpose.
5. Since the jeep is a private jeep and insurance policy is Act policy/Liability only policy.

The issue involved is squarely covered by the judgment of this Court (Kalaburagi Bench) in the case of Divisional Manager, United India Insurance Company Limited and others vs. Shamaraya and others in MFA No.31781/2010 and connected matters disposed of on 22.12.2020.

sentences.text: 6. Therefore, the risk of the inmates of the jeep/car is not covered under the Act policy/Liability only policy.
Therefore, the insurance company is not liable to indemnify the owner and to pay compensation.
Therefore the insurance company is exonerated from paying the compensation.
The owner of the jeep shall pay NC: 2023:KHC-D:12396 compensation to the claimants.
Therefore the appeals are liable to be allowed.

7. Hence, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) All the three appeals are allowed.
ii) The judgment and awards dated 09.11.2012, passed by the tribunal, in MVC Nos.28/2010, 29/2010 and 12/2010, stand modified holding that the insurance company is exonerated from liability to pay compensation and owner of jeep shall pay compensation to the claimants.
iii) The amount in deposit shall be transmitted to the tribunal and refunded to the appellant insurance company.
iv) No order as to costs.
